provider.name: MLX
provider.qualification: original MLX operations and compiled regions plus the admitted upstream-derived BF16 storage-boundary patch

gates: Mac mini Release/static 7/7 correctness and portability
MacBook Air host ASan 4/4 and UBSan 4/4
source, relocated shared and relocated static ordinary C++ consumers
Windows and WSL Apple-OFF public headers 2/2 each
native resource, repeated invocation, completion, failure and close semantics

performance.complete_region: BF16 state/update, checked Scatter/Gather, BF16-F32-BF16, RMSNorm, SiLU gate and residual

validation_selection.reason: Changes after the immutable product candidate are benchmark instrumentation, evidence, documentation and state only.

instrumentation_correction.classification: validator contract correction; no product change
instrumentation_correction.detail: The route-specific validator previously required an admitted patched MLX tree to equal unpatched upstream. It now verifies the clean upstream pin, the exact admitted patch manifest, before/after hashes, patch set and metallib identity.
instrumentation_correction.policy: Do not copy this Apple-specific control density into later M2 batches unless the route card identifies the same risk.

limitations: The MacBook Air P1 profile is engineering qualification, not Formal independent-hardware certification.
Mac mini signs correctness and portability only.
Host sanitizers do not qualify the Metal driver or device memory and macOS ASan did not provide leak detection.
The compiled but unreachable legacy custom Metal scatter and old indexing chain remain frozen for M5 disposition; they do not carry any of these 21 PASS cells.
The other 235 route cells remain UNPROVEN and no one of the 64 requirement rows is complete across all four routes.
